name: Nangoku Aventure
source:
You are, Kyosuke Mita. You have never had date with a girl in your whole life.
Not only you have never dated before, the girl you ask out dumps you. You're depressed about this incident. Out of nowhere, Aunt Asako Shimura comes to visit you. She is a photographer who travels all the time. You have always looked up to her. Noticing that you are depressed, she asks you to be her assistant and invites you to a tropical island. You go to Hasune Island with her. Your aunt brings along the energetic Mizuki Kasuga, her sister, Yuki, and a girl with a nice body, who is a year older than you, Takami Hibiya. It is up to you to decide if you want Asako or a harem with the three girls. Please fulfill your exotic desires on a tropical island this summer!!

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20030222132557/http://gamelexgs.com:80/gameinfo/2001/na/nangoku/]Gamelexgs[/url]]
translation:
你是，三田恭介。你一生中从未与女孩约会过。
不仅你以前从未约会过，而且你约出去的女孩也甩了你。你对这件事感到沮丧。不知为何，志村麻子阿姨来看望你了。她是一位经常旅行的摄影师。你一直仰望她。她注意到你情绪低落，请你做她的助手，并邀请你去一个热带岛屿。你和她一起去哈苏恩岛。你的阿姨带来了精力充沛的春日瑞希、她的妹妹由纪，以及比你大一岁、身材姣好的女孩日比谷高美。想要麻子还是和三个女孩组成后宫，由你决定。今年夏天，请在热带岛屿上满足你的异国情调吧！

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20030222132557/http://gamelexgs.com:80/gameinfo/2001/na/nangoku/]Gamelexgs[/url]]
